title: China and India will have to explain themselves on coal, COP26 president says
主要内容: COP26 President Alok Sharma emphasized that China and India must address their coal usage, as the agreement was amended due to their influence. The pact now refers to 'phase down' rather than 'phase out' of coal, reflecting a compromise. This change highlights the challenge of balancing climate goals with economic development in major coal-burning nations. Sharma acknowledged resistance to including coal-related language in the climate agreement, noting it was the first time coal was addressed in a COP resolution. Further work remains on this issue, as he had previously stated the goal of phasing out coal power. The amendment, influenced by India and China, the world's largest coal burners, sparked initial objections but was eventually accepted by opposing countries.
